lock_mode_before_rebase.meaning: existing lockMode value stored in the OraclePack before rebaseOraclePack executes

lock_mode_after_rebase.meaning: lockMode value stored in the OraclePack after rebaseOraclePack executes

rebase_executed.meaning: rebaseOraclePack executed and completed its state update

assumptions: rebaseOraclePack is the operation that updates the stored lockMode field.
The lockMode field is an integer-encoded value observable before and after the rebase.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the exact prior lockMode value beyond the Guardian setting it to 3, so the before-value is left symbolic rather than fixed to a literal.

limitations: No frozen precondition sources were selected, so P is empty and the claim is conditioned only on the rebase execution trigger.
The impact is formalized as a state-correspondence mismatch between the stored lockMode before and after rebaseOraclePack; downstream attack enablement is not part of this claim.
